lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills, with the most intense clusters located on the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged irregularity and tissue loss on the posterior (trailing) edge of the left pectoral fin, consistent with a significant amputation or traumatic injury.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to and trailing from the damaged edge of the left pectoral fin.
